style.name: Ash & Frost
style.notes: bone-white dragon scale, blackened iron and wolf pelt, breath fog on every exhale, practical firelight only

assets.name: King Oswin Vale
assets.description: A weathered king in his sixties, tall and heavy-shouldered, grey-iron beard cropped square, a long pale scar running from the left brow across the cheek to the jaw, deep-set grey eyes. Wears a wolf-pelt mantle over dented blackened steel plate, a plain iron circlet pressed into unruly grey hair, leather gauntlets worn through at the knuckles. Granite-faced, exhausted, unbroken

assets.name: Maerwyn Ash
assets.description: A wizard in her fifties, lean and severe, scalp shaved clean and tattooed with ash-grey spiral lines that run down behind the ear, left eye milk-pale and blind, right eye dark and sharp. Wears heavy charcoal wool robes layered over frost-stiff linen, hung with small bone charms on wire, sleeves burnt short at the cuff. Weathered hands, soot under the nails

assets.name: Ser Rhogan Dray
assets.description: A sword-captain in his late twenties, wiry and quick, black hair cropped short, a healing split in the lower lip, dark brown eyes. Wears battered steel pauldrons over a mail hauberk and a crimson wool cloak stiff with frost at the hem, a plain leather sword-belt. Young face carrying too much rank

assets.name: Warlord Vhalric the Ember
assets.description: A warlord in his forties, broad and still, jaw and throat marked with old burn scarring. Wears blackened crimson plate armour with soot-dulled rivets and a horned helm split by a single molten-orange seam of light down the faceplate, a charred fur half-cape over one shoulder. Carries himself like a man who takes crowns and never wears them

assets.name: Kaelith the White Wyrm
assets.description: An enormous ancient dragon with bone-white overlapping scales, frost-blue eyes with slit pupils, long ice-rimed horns swept back from a narrow skull, ragged forty-metre wings veined with pale blue, frost crusting the wing joints and spine ridge. Breath is white fire that freezes rather than burns. Vast, indifferent, older than the kingdom

assets.name: Vardenhal Keep
assets.description: A black basalt fortress on a snow cliff above a frozen valley, squat wind-scoured towers, ice-glazed battlements, torn banners on iron poles, a single lit brazier on the rampart, deep snow drifted against the walls

assets.name: The Hall of Oaths
assets.description: A long medieval throne hall of cracked grey stone, tall iron braziers burning low, rows of empty timber benches, faded banners of dead houses hanging from the rafters, a heavy oath table of scarred oak, snow blowing through arrow slits

assets.name: The Frostmere
assets.description: A vast glacial lake locked under black ice, ringed by leaning weather-worn standing stones, pressure ridges and old fractures webbing the surface, low freezing mist, pale dawn light on snowbound mountains behind

assets.name: The Ashfields
assets.description: A burnt open plain of grey snow and cinders under a low iron sky, blackened stumps and broken siege timber, drifting ash, distant treeline, ground churned to frozen mud

assets.name: Winterbite
assets.description: A medieval greatsword with a long notched blade, a rune-etched fuller running its length, permanent frost crusting the steel, wire-wrapped leather grip worn smooth, a plain crossguard of blackened iron

assets.name: The Iron Crown of Vardenhal
assets.description: A plain brutal band of black iron, no jewels, hammer-marked and unpolished, a shallow notch cut into the front, frost condensing on the metal

assets.name: The Ashbound Staff
assets.description: A wizard's staff of blackened bone bound with old wire around a shard of frost-glass at the head, small charms knotted along the shaft, the wood scorched near the grip

shots.title: Vardenhal at blue hour
shots.description: a distant view of @location:Vardenhal_Keep across the frozen valley at blue hour, a single rider on a dark horse crossing the snowfield far below the walls, one brazier burning on the rampart

motion.notes: The rider crosses the snowfield toward the fortress, snow drifting across frame, the rampart brazier guttering in the wind

shots.title: The King on the ramparts
shots.description: @character:King_Oswin_Vale standing at the ice-glazed battlement of @location:Vardenhal_Keep, wolf-pelt mantle snapping in the wind, looking out over the frozen valley, breath fogging

motion.notes: The King's mantle snaps in the wind, his breath fogs, he does not turn — snow streaks past the battlement

shots.title: Frost on Winterbite
shots.description: frost creeping along the notched edge of @prop:Winterbite where it rests against cold stone, rune-etched fuller catching low firelight

shots.title: The count of the dead
shots.description: @character:Ser_Rhogan_Dray delivering the count of the dead to @character:King_Oswin_Vale in a torchlit stone corridor, a frost-stiff muster roll in his fist, neither man looking at the other

shots.title: Alone in the hall
shots.description: the empty interior of @location:The_Hall_of_Oaths, rows of unoccupied benches, @character:King_Oswin_Vale a small seated figure at the far end beside a single burning brazier

motion.notes: The hall holds still, brazier flame breathing, smoke drifting through the shafts of cold light, the seated King motionless

shots.title: Maerwyn out of the smoke
shots.description: @character:Maerwyn_Ash stepping out of brazier smoke in @location:The_Hall_of_Oaths, half her tattooed face lit by firelight and half lost in shadow, blind eye catching the light, @prop:The_Ashbound_Staff in hand

motion.notes: She walks forward out of the smoke, firelight sliding across the tattooed half of her face, charms swinging on the staff

shots.title: The offer lands
shots.description: @character:King_Oswin_Vale in tight close-up as the offer lands, firelight in his deep-set grey eyes, jaw setting, the scar catching the light

shots.title: The crown on the table
shots.description: @prop:The_Iron_Crown_of_Vardenhal set down on the scarred oak oath table, seen from directly above, frost condensing on the black iron, gauntleted hands withdrawing from frame

shots.title: The oath is struck
shots.description: @character:King_Oswin_Vale and @character:Maerwyn_Ash facing each other in silhouette against the blown-out doorway light of @location:The_Hall_of_Oaths, snow driving through the open door between them

motion.notes: The two silhouettes hold their ground as snow drives through the doorway light between them, cloaks moving in the draught

shots.title: Dawn on the Frostmere
shots.description: first light over @location:The_Frostmere, three tiny figures walking out onto the black ice between leaning standing stones, freezing mist low across the surface

motion.notes: The three figures walk out onto the black ice, mist crawling across the surface, the standing stones passing through frame

shots.title: Under the ice
shots.description: seen from beneath the ice of @location:The_Frostmere looking up, the pale bulk of @character:Kaelith_the_White_Wyrm the size of a hill suspended in the dark water below the frozen ceiling, three small silhouettes standing on the surface above

motion.notes: Silt drifts in the black water as the pale shape resolves out of the dark, the silhouettes above shifting on the ice

shots.title: The waking word
shots.description: @character:Maerwyn_Ash in tight close-up, cracked lips shaping the waking word, frost in her eyelashes, blood at the corner of her mouth, breath tearing out in white bursts

shots.title: The fracture
shots.description: a fracture racing across the black ice of @location:The_Frostmere in macro, splintering white through the dark surface, frost dust lifting

motion.notes: The fracture tears across the ice ahead of frame, splitting into branches, frost dust jumping off the surface

shots.title: The lake breaks
shots.description: the ice of @location:The_Frostmere shattering from directly overhead, ice plates heaving apart, the lake blooming white, the three figures scrambling back across the breaking surface

motion.notes: Ice plates heave apart and the lake blooms white beneath, the figures scrambling backward across the breaking surface

shots.title: Kaelith rises
shots.description: @character:Kaelith_the_White_Wyrm rising out of the shattered ice at @location:The_Frostmere, seen from a low angle on the ice, bone-white scales sheeting water, ice-rimed horns against the dawn sky, wings unfolding enormous

motion.notes: The wyrm rises out of the broken lake sheeting water, wings unfolding across the sky, spray and frost falling back onto the ice

shots.title: The judgement
shots.description: extreme close-up of the frost-blue eye of @character:Kaelith_the_White_Wyrm, slit pupil contracting, the small figure of @character:King_Oswin_Vale reflected in the wet surface of it

shots.title: The Ember host
shots.description: the whole of @location:The_Ashfields filled edge to edge with the Ember host, black banners in ranks, war drums, torch smoke drifting over frozen mud

motion.notes: The ranks hold and the black banners lift in the wind, torch smoke dragging across the frozen ground, drums shaking the line

shots.title: Vhalric between banners
shots.description: @character:Warlord_Vhalric_the_Ember standing between two banner-bearers on @location:The_Ashfields, the molten seam of his helm glowing in the grey light, ash falling

shots.title: Two hosts, one field
shots.description: the two hosts drawn up at opposite edges of @location:The_Ashfields with the whole burnt plain empty between them, snow falling into the gap

shots.title: The camp before the field
shots.description: the Vardenhal camp pitched at the edge of @location:The_Ashfields on the last night, rows of low tents and watchfires burning down the slope, sentries small against the dark, snow falling through the firelight

motion.notes: The watchfires breathe and snow drifts through them as the camera crosses the sleeping camp, sentries turning slowly at their posts

shots.title: Whetstone
shots.description: @character:Ser_Rhogan_Dray's scarred hands drawing a whetstone down the notched edge of @prop:Winterbite by firelight, frost melting and refreezing on the steel behind the stone

shots.title: The succession, said out loud
shots.description: @character:King_Oswin_Vale and @character:Ser_Rhogan_Dray sitting across a low watchfire on @location:The_Ashfields at night, neither looking at the other, the King speaking the thing neither of them wants said

motion.notes: The fire moves between them and the older man finally turns his head as the camera settles, breath fogging in the cold

shots.title: What the waking cost
shots.description: @character:Maerwyn_Ash standing alone and tiny on the black ice of @location:The_Frostmere at night facing the vast settled bulk of @character:Kaelith_the_White_Wyrm, @prop:The_Ashbound_Staff fallen at her feet, aurora light low behind the mountains

motion.notes: The frame widens until the woman is almost lost against the wyrm, mist crawling over the ice between them, the creature's slow breathing the only movement

shots.title: The Ember unhelmed
shots.description: @character:Warlord_Vhalric_the_Ember unhelmed at a forge-fire in his own camp, the burn scarring across his jaw and throat lit hard from below, the horned helm resting on the anvil beside him

shots.title: The eye opens
shots.description: the frost-blue eye of @character:Kaelith_the_White_Wyrm opening in the dark, the slit pupil widening, the first grey line of dawn caught in the wet of it

motion.notes: The lid draws back and the slit pupil widens as the first dawn light crosses the eye, frost crystals shifting on the scale around it

shots.title: The charge breaks
shots.description: the charge breaking on @location:The_Ashfields, shields splitting, spears going down, bodies and ash in the air, the line dissolving into chaos

motion.notes: Shields split and men go down as the camera runs the collapsing line, ash and snow thrown up through the frame

shots.title: White fire
shots.description: @character:Kaelith_the_White_Wyrm scouring a line of white freezing fire through the Ember host across @location:The_Ashfields, banners going to frost and ash, men scattering from the burn line

motion.notes: The wyrm sweeps low and the white fire carves through the host, banners flashing to frost, ranks scattering away from the line

shots.title: Two kings in the ash
shots.description: @character:King_Oswin_Vale and @character:Warlord_Vhalric_the_Ember finding each other in the cinders of @location:The_Ashfields, both bleeding, weapons low, ash falling between them

shots.title: Through the plate
shots.description: @prop:Winterbite driven through blackened crimson plate in macro, frost flashing along the rune-etched fuller, the molten seam of the helm guttering out behind

motion.notes: The blade goes through the plate and frost flashes along the fuller, the molten glow behind it guttering out

shots.title: The King goes down
shots.description: @character:King_Oswin_Vale on his knees in the ash of @location:The_Ashfields seen from high above, @prop:The_Iron_Crown_of_Vardenhal fallen in the frozen mud an arm's length away, @prop:Winterbite planted beside him

motion.notes: The kneeling King settles lower as ash drifts down around him, the fallen crown lying just out of reach

shots.title: The duel
shots.description: @character:King_Oswin_Vale and @character:Warlord_Vhalric_the_Ember fighting through the burning wreckage of @location:The_Ashfields, @prop:Winterbite against a heavy ember-forged axe, both men slowed by wounds and armour, ash and sparks between them

motion.notes: Play this as a continuous action sequence that cuts inside itself: open wide on the two men circling in the smoke, cut to a tight low angle as the axe comes down and the greatsword turns it, cut to a close-up of the King's face taking the impact, cut to boots and ash as they break apart, then settle back to the wide as they square up again

shots.title: The shadow stops
shots.description: the vast wing shadow of @character:Kaelith_the_White_Wyrm sweeping across the ash and stopping over @character:Ser_Rhogan_Dray where he kneels, only his silhouette and the shadow readable

shots.title: Rhogan lifts the crown
shots.description: @character:Ser_Rhogan_Dray rising with @prop:The_Iron_Crown_of_Vardenhal in both hands from a low angle, @character:Kaelith_the_White_Wyrm settled enormous behind him on @location:The_Ashfields, crimson cloak heavy with ash

motion.notes: He rises with the crown held in both hands, ash falling from his cloak, the wyrm shifting its weight behind him

shots.title: Kaelith departs
shots.description: @character:Kaelith_the_White_Wyrm flying low away over the broken ice of @location:The_Frostmere at first light, wings throwing spray, the standing stones small beneath

motion.notes: The wyrm crosses the broken lake and climbs away into the first light, wingbeats throwing spray off the open water
